questions.prompt: You're hosting the project site in the cloud. Which questions do you still have to answer?
options: All of them: requests, transactions, storage, sensitive data, tracking, and backups

questions.prompt: Where should the database server live?
options: In the DMZ, reachable from the Internet
On an internal subnet, reachable only from the app servers

questions.prompt: Passwords should be stored encrypted so the site can decrypt and check them.
What's the safest way to handle customers' card numbers?
options: Email them to the shop owner
Use a payment processor and keep only a token

questions.prompt: A customer clicks Buy twice. Which HTTP method makes this a risk, because it isn't idempotent? (one word)
Which method should almost every public web server **disable**?
In the 3-2-1 backup rule, how many copies should be off-site? (number)
A backup isn't proven until you've tested restoring it.
Which keeps an order from being half-saved if the server crashes mid-way?
options: A database transaction with COMMIT and ROLLBACK

questions.prompt: In the worked example, what happens to a request on port 80?
options: It gets a 301 redirect to HTTPS
